Questions, answered

Can't find what you need? Ask our team directly.

Ask on WhatsApp
How do I book a room?

Choose your dates in the booking bar at the top of the page and tap Book on WhatsApp. We reply to confirm availability and the rate. You can also call or email us.

What room types do you have?

Single, double and family rooms. We have 29 rooms that sleep 58 guests, and every room has its own bathroom.

What is in every room?

An en-suite bathroom, Smart TV with limited DSTV, air-conditioning, tea and coffee facilities and unlimited Wi-Fi.

Is the Wi-Fi really unlimited?

Yes. Wi-Fi is free for all guests with no data cap.

Is parking available and safe?

Yes. We have ample secure parking, and security staff are on site 24 hours a day.

What are the rates, check-in and check-out times?

Rates depend on the room type and your dates. Message or call us and we will confirm the rate and the times when you book.

Can I book for a family or a group?

Yes. Our family rooms suit families, and with space for 58 guests we can host small groups. Tell us your group size on WhatsApp.

Where are you and how do I contact you?

We are in Seapoint, Maseru, Lesotho, 10115. Call +266 6255 9600 or +266 5855 9600, or email joyseapoint@gmail.com.
